---
title: "CI & Reproducibility"
---

## CI Role

CI is the reference mechanism for reproducibility:

- environment resolution,
- dependency installation,
- HEPData download with caching,
- deterministic execution,
- website rendering checks.

## CI Workflow

The project includes a GitHub Actions workflow at:

- `.github/workflows/site.yml`

It runs Pixi tasks so local and CI commands stay aligned.

`data/` is cached in GitHub Actions. CI restores cached HEPData first and only runs `pixi run fetch-data` on cache misses.
If cached files are missing or incomplete, CI triggers an explicit fallback fetch and validates the required files.

## Typical CI Steps

```bash
pixi install
pixi run bootstrap
pixi run instantiate
pixi run fetch-data
pixi run run-model
pixi run build-dashboard-data
pixi run render-site
```
